settings.title: Refund, Return & Cancellation Policy
settings.content:
1. 7-Day Replacement Guarantee

If your bottle arrives damaged, leaking, or with a broken seal/tampered hologram during transit, please WhatsApp our support team at +91-98800-00000 within 7 days of delivery with an unboxing photo or video. We will immediately dispatch a free replacement bottle with zero extra charge.

2. Order Cancellation

You can cancel your order anytime before it is dispatched from our Mysore hub by sending an email or WhatsApp message with your Order ID.

3. Prepaid & COD Refunds

In case of eligible returns or cancellations where payment was processed, the full refund amount will be credited back to your original payment mode or bank account via UPI within 5-7 business days.
